obligations.requirement: The fixed fixture traverses canonical bootstrap, production Scene/RuntimeScene, bounds-driven visibility, DirectReference, FramePlan, FrameOrchestrator, and the private Headless backend without a hand-built final render input.
obligations.oracle: Require the exact production stage order; require IDs 501 through 509 in canonical, Scene, and RuntimeScene; require IDs 501 through 508 in visibility, Scene draw list, DirectReference, and backend traversal; require Group 509 absent from pixel-stage membership and prohibit manual downstream injection.
obligations.acceptance: Nine structural records and eight pixel records are exact, ordered, and observed through their owning production stages; Group remains RuntimeScene-findable and has no pixel entry.
obligations.evidence_required: Committed demo CLI evidence plus review-owned pipeline, membership, and source-bypass scan.

obligations.requirement: Identical fixed input rendered twice emits byte-identical artifacts matching the independently authored expected descriptor.
obligations.oracle: Byte-compare all three artifacts from two clean runs; externally compare fixture/render hashes and every frozen expected descriptor field; sample retained and erased VectorStroke pixels and the Group zero-pixel region.
obligations.acceptance: Both runs exit zero; files are byte-identical; raster byte count, hashes, digest, fixed samples, mask behavior, and Group zero-pixel observation match the independent descriptor.
obligations.evidence_required: Artifact determinism evidence with external hashes, exact field comparisons, and pixel samples.

obligations.requirement: All nine V1 semantic kinds remain in canonical and runtime state, while only the eight objects with pixel-relevant bounds enter visibility and reference rendering.
obligations.oracle: Independently decode the snapshot and assert IDs 501 through 509 plus all nine kinds in canonical storage and RuntimeScene; assert all nine Scene records under the frozen coarse mapping; assert exactly IDs 501 through 508 and their eight semantic kinds in visibility, draw, DirectReference, and backend traversal; assert RuntimeScene find succeeds for Group 509 and Group contributes no pixels.
obligations.acceptance: Structural stages contain nine exact records; pixel stages contain eight exact records; Group is structurally present, absent from pixel membership, and contributes zero pixels.
obligations.evidence_required: Nine-kind structural inventory plus eight-kind pixel-pipeline membership evidence.

obligations.requirement: Argument, fixture, render, or publication failures are deterministic and never publish partial or stale success artifacts.
obligations.oracle: Exercise missing, unknown, duplicate, and positional arguments; missing, malformed, unsupported, and invalid fixtures; non-integral Shape rejection; unavailable parent; and an existing successful output directory, comparing the destination before and after.
obligations.acceptance: Every failure exits nonzero; an absent destination remains absent; an existing successful destination remains byte-identical; no partial PASS evidence is published.

obligations.requirement: G3-07 remains a demo consumer and preserves G2 plus G3-01 through G3-06 while using the accepted prebuilt Skia SDK.
obligations.oracle: Run authorized-path and forbidden-dependency scans, focused G3 tests, the complete RF01/G2 matrix, full CTest, SDK identity checks, and git diff --check against the anchor.
obligations.acceptance: Only authorized G3-07 and evidence paths differ; production contracts and dependency locks are unchanged; all frozen matrices pass with the accepted SDK and no source fallback.
obligations.evidence_required: Scope, dependency identity, regression, and diff evidence.

explicit_non_requirements: Group 509 need not appear in bounds-driven visibility, Scene draw-list membership, DirectReference pixel entries, or backend traversed kinds.
GT-G3-07 does not introduce Group subtree bounds, Group transforms over descendants, clip, opacity, blend isolation, or structural render traversal.
No G2 BoundsSystem, Scene query, spatial-index, DirectReferenceSource, canonical type, or publication semantic change is authorized.
